ac_results.ac: `src/rules.mjs` exports `checkRules(pairs, schema)` returning `{findings, schemaErrors}`; `node --test test/rules.test.mjs` exits 0 (covers: REQ-20)

a schema of the form `{KEY: {required?, type?, enum?}}` is accepted; any other shape (not an object, unknown field, unknown type, non-string-array enum) yields non-empty `schemaErrors` and `findings: []` (covers: REQ-1)
ac_results.evidence: test 'bad schema shapes yield schemaErrors and no findings'

ac_results.ac: `required: true` with the key absent yields `{key, line: null, rule: "required"}`; `K=` counts as present (covers: REQ-17)
`type` `string` always passes; `int` accepts `^-?[0-9]+$`; `bool` accepts exactly `true`/`false`; a failing value yields `rule: "type"` with the pair's line (covers: REQ-18)
`type: url` accepts `https://x.com/p` and `postgres://u@h:5432/db`, and rejects `foo:bar`, `localhost:3000`, `http://` and `not a url` (covers: REQ-27)
`enum` rejects a value not in the list, with `rule: "enum"` (covers: REQ-19)
`src/rules.mjs` has no import of a parse module and no `http`/`https`/`net`/`fetch` use; a test asserts this by reading the file (covers: REQ-21)
`checkRules([], null)`, `checkRules([], [])` and `checkRules([], "x")` return schemaErrors without throwing (covers: REQ-7)
ac_results.evidence: test 'null/array/string schema returns schemaErrors without throwing'

assumptions: pairs have shape {key, value, line} per UC-EvaluateRules; non-array pairs treated as empty
schema key whose rule is not an object is a schema error
